requirements.title: IEEE_SET_FLAG FLAG argument restrictions
requirements.definition: FLAG shall be a scalar or array of type IEEE_FLAG_TYPE; the named exception flag values assign corresponding exception flags; no two FLAG elements shall have the same value.

pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-FLAG-ieee-flag-type: Positive source controls probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), use FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), then call IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.TRUE.); array control additionally probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_UNDERFLOW,1.0), uses FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_UNDERFLOW,1.0), and calls IEEE_SET_FLAG([IEEE_OVERFLOW,IEEE_UNDERFLOW],[.TRUE.,.FALSE.]) with IEEE_FLAG_TYPE actuals. Source-control mutation uses a logical FLAG actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-FLAG-named-exception-value: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,1.0) separately for IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT; supported branch applies FLAG-HALTING-OFF(flag,1.0), then uses that named value in a scalar IEEE_SET_FLAG call. Unsupported flags skip.
pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-FLAG-no-duplicates: Positive source control probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_UNDERFLOW,1.0), applies FLAG-HALTING-OFF to both flags, then uses array [IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_UNDERFLOW] with distinct values. Source-control mutation duplicates IEEE_OVERFLOW and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: IEEE_SET_FLAG FLAG_VALUE restrictions
requirements.definition: FLAG_VALUE shall be a logical scalar or array conformable with FLAG.

pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-FLAG_VALUE-logical: Positive source controls probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), apply FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), then call IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.TRUE.) and IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.FALSE.) with logical FLAG_VALUE. Source-control mutation uses integer FLAG_VALUE and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-FLAG_VALUE-conformable: Positive source control probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_UNDERFLOW,1.0), applies FLAG-HALTING-OFF to both flags, then passes a two-element FLAG array and a two-element logical FLAG_VALUE array. Mutation passes a one-element FLAG_VALUE array and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: IEEE_SET_FLAG sets scalar exception flags signaling or quiet
requirements.definition: A true FLAG_VALUE sets the corresponding exception flag to signaling; a false FLAG_VALUE sets it to quiet.

pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-true-sets-signaling: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), applies FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), and probes IEEE_GET_FLAG observer support; supported branch calls IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.FALSE.), verifies quiet, then IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.TRUE.) and verifies signaling. Mutation reverses the logical value.
pending.IEEE_SET_FLAG-false-sets-quiet: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), applies FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_OVERFLOW,1.0), and probes IEEE_GET_FLAG observer support; supported branch calls IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.TRUE.), verifies signaling, then IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,.FALSE.) and verifies quiet. Mutation omits the false set.
